name: Weekly Growth Recap
subtitle: Your week in review: wins, patterns, and next week's focus.
summary: Pulls your follower trend, post performance, any new leads, and your latest audience replies, then writes a short recap of the week: what worked, one pattern to repeat, and a focus for next week. Purely a look back at what happened.
howToAsk: What worked for me this week?
get: follower change, top posts with why they worked, lead count, one pattern, one next-week focus.
launchPrompt: Give me my weekly recap: follower trend, top posts and why they worked, any new leads, and one focus for next week.
